svg.text: Autopilot over one week when you don't use Claude yourself
Simulated with the real decide() policy · learned k = 0.10 weekly % per 1% of the 5h window · 0.55% of the window per run-minute
Minutes of autopilot work per hour
≈ 30 h of work in 11 windows (4.2 h/day). Your own usage opens windows and raises weekly %, so autopilot then keeps to each window's tail.
